releaseState: Current production and source-qualified landing match; no deployment was performed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: The hero explains semantic Gmail recall, sender-volume understanding, and durable filter recipes while making the read-only and browser-local boundaries explicit. Audience, mechanism, proof, and open-app action are all visible without relying on feature jargon.

designQuality.evidence: The existing Kinetic landing is a polished adaptation of the shared narrative system, not a generic dashboard. Fresh 390 and 1440 pixel renders have strong hierarchy, real product demonstration, deliberate section rhythm, both shared footer elements, zero overflow, and no console errors.

seo.evidence: Production passes all critical page and site-level SEO checks: title, 140-character description, canonical, Open Graph, social card, headings, content depth, robots, and sitemap coverage. Link crawl found zero errors or redirects; four SPA routes are deliberately canonicalized to the landing and excluded from the public sitemap.

geo.evidence: Production agent-index audit is S-tier 100 with real llms.txt, /api/ai, homepage Markdown, robots, sitemap, JSON-LD, and complete catalog integrity.

performance.evidence: Four-profile PSI Swarm qualification produced weighted LCP 0.693 s, mobile-mid 0.900 s, mobile-fast 0.496 s, desktop 0.304 s, harsh mobile-slow 1.820 s, CLS 0.003, and TBT 0 with no actionable opportunities.
